svg.title: renanbazinin's GitHub contribution calendar playing Conway's Game of Life
svg.desc: The last year of contributions (2,317) is shown first; then every day with a contribution becomes a living cell and the board evolves under the B3/S23 rules for 53 generations.
svg.text: Conway's Game of Life, seeded with my last year on GitHub

g.text: My real calendar: 2,317 contributions in the last year.
Every day with a contribution becomes a living cell. Rules: B3/S23.
